mapper.select: SELECT c.seq, c.board_seq, c.member_id, m.nickname AS member_nickname, c.content, c.parent_seq, c.depth, c.created_at, c.updated_at, c.is_deleted FROM board_comment c LEFT JOIN member m ON c.member_id = m.id WHERE c.board_seq = #{boardSeq} AND c.is_deleted = 'N' ORDER BY NVL(c.parent_seq, c.seq), -- 부모 없으면 자기 seq 기준 c.depth, c.created_at
mapper.insert:
SELECT board_comment_seq.NEXTVAL FROM dual
INSERT INTO board_comment ( seq, board_seq, member_id, member_nickname, content, created_at, updated_at, is_deleted ) VALUES ( #{seq}, #{board_seq}, #{member_id}, #{member_nickname}, #{content}, SYSDATE, SYSDATE, 'N' )
mapper.update: UPDATE board_comment SET content = #{content}, updated_at = SYSDATE WHERE seq = #{seq} AND member_id = #{member_id} AND is_deleted = 'N'
UPDATE board_comment SET is_deleted = 'Y', updated_at = SYSDATE WHERE seq = #{seq} AND member_id = #{member_id} AND is_deleted = 'N'
